Strict robust accuracy as the budget grows

The robust arm trades 100% -> 80% clean accuracy for 20% -> 80% strict robust accuracy here.
Robust gate (>=75%): clean arm FAIL, robust arm PASS. No test-driven model selection.
A strict margin of zero fails conservatively; prediction uses +1 at a score tie.
All-real input domain, no box clipping. Analytic identity in float64, not interval-certified arithmetic.
Independent implementation. Norm-ball semantics: Kolter/Madry tutorial; arXiv:2208.09449, Theorem 2.
